opening_question: Namaste. Bukhaar ke baare mein thoda aur bataiye — kab se mehsoos ho raha hai?

mandatory_slots.question: Bukhaar kab se hai — aaj se, kal se, ya kai dinon se?
Bukhaar kitna tez hai? Agar thermometer se naapa hai to kitna tha?
Bukhaar lagatar rehta hai ya sham/raat ko badh jaata hai?

screening_questions.question: Bukhaar ke saath thand lagti hai ya kaanpna (shivering) hota hai?
Badan mein dard ya kamzori mehsoos hoti hai?
Shareer par koi rash ya laal daane dikhe hain?
Saans lene mein takleef ho rahi hai?
Pichle 2 hafton mein kahin bahar (dusre shehar/gaanv) gaye the?

background_slots.question: Pehle kabhi malaria, dengue, typhoid, ya aisi koi bimari hui hai?
Bukhaar ke liye koi dawai already li hai?
